purpose: Line budgets for src/Strata.Application/SchemaDiff/*.fs (STRATA-QUAL-001, strata#14). SchemaDiff.fs grew to 3694 lines in two days because nothing pushed back. Enforced by SchemaDiffArchitectureTests (every module budgeted; lines <= budget; budget - lines <= slack; budget <= ceiling unless an unexpired exception covers it) and by scripts/check-schemadiff-budget-ratchet.sh (on a pull request, no budget, ceiling or slack may rise above the base branch's value unless an unexpired exception names that module). To grow a module past its budget, prefer splitting it; otherwise add an exception with an owner, a reason and an expiry date, and expect review to ask why.
